name: Corporate Action Narrative 1
definition: Provides addtional information such as the taxation conditions.

InformationConditions.name: Information Conditions
InformationConditions.definition: Provides conditional information related to the event, eg, an offer is subject to 50% acceptance, the offeror allows the securities holder to set some conditions.

InformationToComplyWith.name: Information To Comply With
InformationToComplyWith.definition: Provides information conditions to the account owner that are to be complied with, eg, not open to US/Canadian residents, QIB or SIL to be provided.

TaxationConditions.name: Taxation Conditions
TaxationConditions.definition: Provides taxation conditions that cannot be included within the structured fields of this message.

NewCompanyName.name: New Company Name
NewCompanyName.definition: Provide the new name of a company following a name change.

Offeror.name: Offeror
Offeror.definition: Provides the entity making the offer and is different from the issuing company.

URLAddress.name: URL Address
URLAddress.definition: Provides the web address published for the event, ie the address for the Universal Resource Locator (URL), eg, used over the www (HTTP) service.

AdditionalText.name: Additional Text
AdditionalText.definition: Provides additional information or specifies in more detail the content of a|message.
